sanskrit: bhūtaśuddhiṃ dehaśuddhiṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ parammantraṃ yantraṃ mahādeva yena śudhyati bhūtaletattvatrayaṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ mahattasya sarvārthahāniḥ syājjapaṃ ca viphalaṃ priyeprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tattvatrayamidaṃ smṛtamakārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkākṣararūpiṇīmāgatya devadeveśi ! yāgamaṇḍalasanīdhimantaḥsnānaṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca kathayāmi śṛṇu priye !praṇavena maheśāni ! jīvaṃ dhṛtvā śucismitesnāyācca vimale tīrthe puṣkare hṛdayānvitesaṅgaṃ paraśive kṛtvā ānanda upajāyatetatastu parameśāni ajapāṃ prāṇarūpiṇīmantaḥsandhyāṃ maheśāni ! kuru yatnena pārvatisā sandhyā kulasādhūnāṃ samādhisthaḥ pratīyateajapāṃ parameśāna ! kathyatāṃ me dayānidhe !dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā japennaraḥṣaṭcakraṃ madhyagaṃ kṛtvā ajapāṃ paramākṣarāmbindvarddhaṃ candrasaṃyuktaṃ kuru yatnena sundari !etajjapaṃ vinā devi bhūtaśuddhiśca niṣphalāaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācarettāni sarvāṇi deveśi jīvaṃ saṃnyasya pārvatimūlādhārānmaheśāni ! mūlapadmaṃ śucismiteraktavarṇaṃ sadā sevyaṃ yogibhiḥ parameśvari !tanmadhye bhāvayed devaṃ śivaṃ śyāmalasundaramśivaṃ veṣṭya maheśāni ! sarvadā tatra tiṣṭhati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmaviṣṇustutāṃ devīṃ kuṇḍalīṃ brahmarūpiṇīmcaturdalayutaṃ varṇaṃ tāraṇaṃ vighnanāśanamajapānāṃ maheśāni ! caturdalagataṃ kurutatpurīṃ ca maheśāni ! nīreṇa paripūritamnīreṇa śobhitaṃ devi ! svādhiṣṭhānaṃ śucismiteva - bha - ma - ya - ra - lairyuktaṃ kundapuṣpasamanvitammūlādhārāt samutthāpya kuṇḍalīṃ brahmarūpiṇīmbindvardhasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā śobhitaṃ śivamarcayetṣaḍdalaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ devi ! gudaṃ ca caturaṅgulam|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde prathamaḥ paṭalaḥvāyuṃ ca tatra vai nītvā manasā parameśvaritato brahmanadīṃ bhittvā vāyurmaṇipuraṃ yayautatpātraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca akṣaraṃ kṛṣṇarūpakammaṇipūraṃ maheśāni ! mahāmarakataprabhamḍakārādikakārāntaṃ bindvardhasaṃyutaṃ kurudaśapatraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ akṣaraṃ kṛṣṇarūpakamdaśākṣarajapād devi daśajanmāghanāśadamādityapatrasaṃyuktaṃ varṇairdvādaśabhiryutamkādiṭhāntākṣarairvarṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ paramākṣarampradīpakalikākāraṃ tanmadhye brahmarūpiṇamsammukhe tasya deveśi ! jīvastiṣṭhati sarvadāvāyuṃ tejoyutaṃ jīvaṃ dṛṣṭvā manolayaṃ kuruyakārasyāṣṭasaṃbījaṃ jīvaṃ hemaprabhaṃ sadākṛtvā japaṃ maheśāni ! yatnena kuru sundaritatsarvaṃ nāśayatyeva tatkṣaṇāt parameśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśuddhaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyutamtasya madhye sthitaṃ devi ākāśaṃ śaktirūpiṇammanastatra maheśāni ! sārathiḥ sarvataḥ sadāsvaraṃ ca ṣoḍaśaṃ devi bindvardhasaṃyutaṃ kurupūrvādikramato devi daśadhā prajapet priyedahet tasya japād devi tṛṇaṃ vahniryathā dahettatpurīṃ parameśāni dvidalaṃ yugavarṇakambindvardhasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā sādhako japamācaretājñāṃ purīṃ nayet śīghraṃ mano manasi bhāvanamgurorājñādhāraṇāt tu ājñāpuramimaṃ smṛtamevaṃ prapañcaṃ bhittvā vai kuṇḍalīṃ jīvasaṃyutāmpañcaprāṇasamāyuktā caturviṃśatisaṃyutābuddhyahaṅkāracittāni nayet śivapuraṃ pratitatra gatvā maheśāna kuṇḍalī kimakarot prabhoindriyairakṣarairdevi ! ekatvaṃ jāyate yadāsarvātmasampuṭaṃ devi ! sarvavidyābhidhāraṇamiti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥguhyād guhyataraṃ devi sugopyaṃ bhuvanatrayesaṃveṣṭya paramā devī yatrāste parameśvari !akārādikṣakārāntāḥ sarvabīje niyojayetprajapya daśadhā devi ! kuṇḍalīṃ paramāṃ vrajetsahasradalasaṃyuktaṃ padmaṃ nityāgamaṃ priyesadāśivo maheśāni ! yatrāste parameśvariśivaṃ prāpya maheśāni ! kuṇḍalī śivasannidhausarvatra sampuṭaṃ dattvā mohayet paramaṃ śivam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmamadhye sthitaṃ devaṃ nirīhaṃ śavarūpavatśaktisaṃyogamātreṇa karmakartā sa ucyateśaktiṃ vinā maheśāni na kiñcidapi vartatesadāśivapuraṃ devi vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ padamsadāśivena ca samaṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ ramet priye !tenāmṛtena deveśi ṣaṭcakraṃ plāvayet kramātguhyād guhyataraṃ ramyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhamprāṇamantreṇa deveśi ! śaktiṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ parāmsahasrāre śiraḥpadme pare brahmaṇi yojayettasmāt sarvāṇi tattvāni bījarūpeṇa bhāvayetsarvapāpātmakaṃ krūraṃ puruṣaṃ piṅgamūrdhajamdaśadhā vāyumutṣādya vapuḥ pāpaṃ viśodhayetraktaṃ vibhāvya daśadhā tajjapācca hutāśanamlalāṭe vāruṇaṃ bījaṃ śuddhaṃ sañcintya tajjapātsarvavyathāvinirmuktaṃ jātaṃ divyavapustataḥavagatya dharābījaṃ mūlādhāre vicintayettataḥ sarvāṇi bījāni tattvāni ca śucismiteājñādiguṇapadmāntaṃ saṃsthāpya parameśvari !etad rahasyaṃ paramaṃ sadā mama hṛdi sthitambījaṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ devi ājñācakraṃ samānayetpañcāśanmātṛkāmantraṃ daśadhā prajapet priyelambayet parameśāni jīvaṃ kuṇḍalinīsahataccakre parameśāni mātṛkāvarṇamuttamamsarvaṃ hi manasā kāryaṃ manaḥ sarvārthasādhakamlambayet praṇavairdevi purīṃ[prati]dhvanimayīṃ prati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavena tu mantreṇa tarpayet śivarūpiṇamtarpayet mūlamantreṇa mātṛkājapapūrvakamtatrasthāṃ daśakalāṃ devi ! mūlamantreṇa tarpayettadadhaḥ parameśāni ! svādhiṣṭhāneṣu lambayettatrasthaṃ śivadevaṃ ca mūlamantreṇa tarpayettatrasthāṃ ṣaṭkalāṃ divyāṃ māyābījena tarpayetmanaḥsārathinā devi ! śivaṃ sambhāvya yatnataḥtato yugakalāṃ nityāṃ mūlamantreṇa tarpayetsvasthānaṃ prāpya deveśi ! kuṇḍalī paradevatājavāsindūrasaṅkāśāmudyadbhāskarasannibhāmtatastu parameśāni ! jīvaṃ puṣkaramānayetbrahmasthānaṃ ca tad devi ! sūryamaṇḍalasannibhampradīpakalikākāraṃ śabdabrahma śucismiteśabdabrahma paraṃ brahma śaktiyuktaṃ sadā priye !śaktiḥ sarveṣu deveṣu devīṣu ca śucismitepretalokaṃ sa gatvā vai śūkaratvaṃ prajāyate|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥraudrī ca parameśāni ! sadā śirasi saṃsthitāraudrī rudraṃ tu vijñeyā bindutrayamitīritābindunā parameśāni ! karmakartā sadā priyebindunā jāyate sṛṣṭiḥ pālanaṃ ca śucismitebinduṃ vinā maheśāni ! sakalaṃ pretavat priyemūlādhāre maheśāni ! tryakṣarīṃ daśadhā japetśivabījaṃ samuddhṛtya pṛthvībījapuṭaṃ kuruhṛtpadme rañjitaśivā samuddhṛtya śucismite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lalāṭe parameśāni ! ralabījaṃ samuddharaetā vidyā maheśāni ! bhūtaśuddhestu kāraṇamkṛpayā kathayeśāna ! yadyahaṃ tava vallabhājīvaḥ śuddhātmako bhūtvā manasā parameśvarapunastu puruṣaṃ pāpaṃ kathamutpadyate tathāsaṃśayaṃ me mahādeva ! chindhi deva dayānidheśoṣaṇairdahanairdevi ! puruṣaṃ pāparūpakamiḍā tu vāmadeśe hi sadā tiṣṭhati pārvatināḍīsaṃyogamātreṇa pāpamūlaṃ nikṛntatipunarutpadyate devi ! japapūjāvidheranudahantaṃ śeṣapāpaṃ ca nāśanaṃ yadi cecchasikāmanayā tathā devi ! manmathaṃ parameśvarimano jīvātmanoḥ śuddhiḥ prāṇayāmena sundarisarveṣu viṣṇumantreṣu śivamantre gaṇādhipeevaṃ te kathitaṃ devi ! rahasyaṃ paramādbhutammaṇipuram agnitattvaṃ vāyutattvamanāhatemanastattvaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ ca manaḥ sarvatra vyāpakamyāvasti parameśāni bhūtaśuddhyāṃdi yāni casarvagāmī sarvavettā sarvasākṣī sadā manaḥmantraṃ vidyā maheśāni ! manasā japamācaret|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde caturthaḥ paṭalaḥmanaḥ pravibhave devi ! unmanīsahitā yataḥjīvasya parameśāni ! guptatattvaṃ śṛṇu priyepraṇavena samākṛṣya dvādaśāntaṃ layet sudhīḥhṛtpadme ca maheśāni paraṃ brahma nirīkṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇipūraṃ tato gatvā snāpayenmanasā sahatato jīvaṃ maheśāni ! mūlādhāraṃ layet priyesaṃhatya sadasatkarma jīvaḥ sarvaṃ karoti hivāmapārśve sthitaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣeṇa yadā priyepāpasya parameśāni ! saṃyogo yadi jāyateśuddhasattvātmako jīvastasya kāryaṃ kutaḥ priyejīvasya vāmapārśve tu tadā tiṣṭhati pāpadhṛkunmajjanti nimajjanti prapañceṣu śucismitejāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāṃ cāpi parameśvaritatra kuṇḍalinī devi yātāyātaṃ karoti hikadācit śuklapadmaṃ hi vahnipadmaṃ kadā priyeprapañcānāṃ maheśāni ! devānucaramuttamamyajjñātvā sādhako devi sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāttava snehānmaheśāni ! nigadāmi śucismitekaumārī vaiṣṇavī durgā nārasiṃhī ca kālikāśāṅkarī ca jayantī ca viśuddhapadmasaṃsthitāśākambharī ca bhīmā ca gāṇḍā ca bhrāmarī tathāetāstu parameśāni ! hṛtpadme saṃsthitāḥ sadāaparṇā ca maheśāni tathā vāmā mahodarīkṣemaṅkarī ca deviśi ! maṇipūre sthitā sadācaṇḍā caiva pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍanāyakasevitāmahādevī maheśāni tathaiva moharupiṇīetāstu parameśāni mūlādhāre sthitāḥ sadāakṣaraṃ yugalaṃ devi ājñācakre sthitā sadāetajjñānaṃ maheśāni sadāśivavyavasthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthitikartā bhaved viṣṇurbrahmā sṛṣṭikaraṃ sadātadbīje puṭitaṃ kṛtvā devānāṃ japamācaretanyathā pretavacchuddhirjāyate kamalekṣaṇeṣaṭcakre parameśāni ! yatnato japamācaretkalāvṛkṣe samo bhūtvā sādhakaḥ khecaro bhavetaṇimā sūkṣmarūpaṃ ca laghimā sthūlarūpakammanaḥkleśakaraṃ caiva prākāśyaṃ kamalānanetadaiva mahimā devi ! mama jñāneṣu vartatebrahmāṇḍavaśarūpaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ kathitaṃ priye !aṇimādiguṇaṃ devi ! tava bhaktyā prakāśitamśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi bhūtaśuddhestu kāraṇametajjñānaprabhāveṇa bhūtaśuddheḥ phalaṃ bhavet|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥyajjñātvā parameśāni śivo'haṃ mṛtyunāśakaḥyajjñātvā viṣṇudevaśca sthitikartā śucismitecandraḥ sūryo maheśāni yajjñātvā parameśvariavyaktarūpiṇīṃ ramyāṃ yogagamyāṃ sadā priyeśarīraṃ dvividhaṃ devi ! sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śucismiteviṇmūtrasthe haraṃ caiva vātapitte tu saṅgatamiḍā vāme sthitā nāḍī śuklā tu candrarūpiṇītanmadhye parameśāni ! suṣumnā brahmarūpiṇīmūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati sarvadātisraḥ koṭyaḥ sahasraṃ tu śarīre nāḍyo matāḥvāmanāḍyāṃ maheśāni ! vāyubījena pūrayetmaṇipūre maheśāni catuḥṣaṣṭhī ca dhārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahnibījaṃ maheśāni ! hṛtpadme pūrvavat priyelalāṭe vāruṇaṃ bījaṃ śuklaṃ sañcintya sundarievaṃ dvādaśadhā devi bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaretpūrvoktaṃ parameśāni sāmānyaṃ śuddhimeva cadehasya sūkṣmarūpasya bhūtaśuddhiriyaṃ priyejīvena saha deveśi suṣumnāyāṃ nimajjayetprajapet parayā bhaktyā mālayā varṇasaṅkhyayāmanonmanīyute jīvaḥ brahmarandhre ca saṃjapetjīvaḥ śuddho bhaved devi gaṇaiḥ parikaraiḥ sahaakṣiṇī nāsike karṇau jihvā ca kamalekṣaṇenābhiṃ ca parameśāni ! manaśca parameśvarimanaśca parameśāni ! unmanī bhavanāśinījāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthā etad devi trayaṃ smṛtamindriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ manaḥ paramasārathiḥsvakarma bhajate devi ! unmanī satataṃ priyerodanaṃ mohamūrcche ca kṣudhā tṛṣṇā śucismitejobo nityo'vyayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvavit paraḥpradīpakalikākāraḥ sarvaḥ prāpya vijṛmbhatekoṭisūryapratīkāśāṃ svarṇadīṃ pāpanāśinīmsākṣād brahmahradākārāṃ nānāsukhavihāriṇīmjñānavijñānasaṃyuktāṃ cidākārāṃ sanātanīmvāmapārśve sthitāṃ nityāṃ brahmarūpāṃ taḍinmayīmtanmadhyasthāṃ maheśāni amṛtabhavapūritāmvāmanāḍī maheśāni suptirūpā puraḥsthitā---------------dakṣiṇe piṅgalāśritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vicitrā parameśāni turīyā parigīyateśuddhaḥ sattvātmako jīva iṣṭadevīṃ hṛdi nyasetvāratrayaṃ maheśāni yātāyātaṃ karoti hina kasmaicit pravaktavyaṃ paśave kamalekṣaṇeetattatvaṃ maheśāni hṛdaye kuru yatnataḥetattattvaṃ maheśāni brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥanyad vada maheśāna yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāśūlapāṇe mahādeva kṛpayā kathaya prabhotava snehānmaheśāni nigadāmi punaḥ punaḥyāni yānīha tiṣṭhanti rahasyaṃ kamalekṣaṇetrayodaśātmakaṃ [devi] bindvarddhacandrasaṃyutambrahmasthānaṃ sadā sevyamānaṃ parameśvariarddhayoniṃ tadupari binduṃ nirvikāraṃ nirīhamtaṃ binduṃ sadā bhāvaya pārvatibinduṃ bhāvaya deveśi kiṃ japena śucismitepūjābhāve maheśāni hṛdaye cintayet śivāmkiṃ tasya dhyānapūjāyāṃ binduṃ bhāvaya pārvatijīvonmanī ca deveśi sarvāṇi brahma kāraṇamtāni sarvāṇi deveśi prakṛteḥ paramaṃ vapuḥprakṛtiḥ parameśāni brahmaṇo'vyaktamavyayamśaktiṃ vinā maheśāni brahma vai śavarūpavatprakṛtyā saha saṃyogaṃ sadā yāti nirañjanaḥata eva maheśāni śaktiprādhānyamucyateśaktiṃ binā maheśāni brahmāṇḍaṃ śavarūpavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sā strīrūpā mahādevi hetubhūtā sanātanīsārātsārataraṃ ramyaṃ ātmamadhyasthitaṃ sadāśivasya yuvatīṃ bhadrāṃ koṭikandarpasaṃyutāmtantroktavidhinā devi dhyāyet paramasundarīmmūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ nadīṃ brahmasvarūpiṇīmvāyuṃ vahniṃ tadā devi varuṇaṃ tadanantarambhūtaśuddhirmaheśāni tatkṣaṇādapi jāyateindriyāṇāñca sarveṣāṃ sarvatattvaṃ śucismiteśarīraṃ dvividhaṃ devi sthūlaṃ sūkṣmamidaṃ smṛtamsūkṣmaṃ saṃśodhya vidhivat sthūlañca tadanantaramjīvañca parameśāni brahmanadyāṃ śucismitetato jīvo maheśāni vāmanāsāpuṭe priyesamānīya vahnirūpaṃ sākṣāt paramasundarīmtatra gatvā maheśāni bhāvayediṣṭadevatāmsadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ navayauvanasaṃyutāmśuklakṛṣṇāruṇayutāṃ pītāṃ nīlasamāvṛtāmkiṅkiṇī ca tathā kaṭyāṃ ratnakāñcanamaṇḍitāmkandarpakoṭilāvaṇyāṃ sadāmṛtavivarddhinīmmukhāravindagandhenāmoditaṃ paramaṃ śivamśivaśaktisamāyogādānandaṃ jāyate drutam|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde saptamaḥ paṭalaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā siddho bhavati nānyathātasmin kṣaṇe maheśāni puruṣaṃ pāparupiṇampāpasya gamanaṃ nāsti sadāśivapuraṃ priyeṣaṭcakre parameśāni kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā japenmanum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaṭcakraṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ sadā śivapurīsamammuhūrtābhyantare devi yātāyātaṃ karoti yaḥyaḥ karoti prasannātmā suṣumnāmadhyavartiniekoccāreṇa girije koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhetmānasoccāraṇād devi japāt siddhiḥ prajāyateantaḥpūjā maheśāni bāhyakoṭisamaṃ smṛtamantaḥ sūkṣmaṃ bahiḥ sthūlaṃ sarvāgamamataṃ priyena śuddhiṃ parameśāni vastrādīni śucismiteantaḥpūjā maheśāni tejaḥpuñjasya bhāvanamsūkṣmadehe maheśāni sūkṣmapūjā vidhīyatesukṣmā tu paramā pūjā sākṣāt prakṛtirūpiṇībrahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sā pūjā iṣṭadevatāsarvaṃ hi parameśāni paratejasi līyatesarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ yāti paratejasi arpaṇātnirākāraṃ nirīhañca rahitamindriyeṇa cayad yat karmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tattadakṣayamāpnuyāttasya pūjā maheśāni kadācinnāsti pārvatikāryañca parameśāni śaktiśca satataṃ priyeyastu satataṃ devi īśvare niścalaḥ sadāata eva maheśāni brahmaśaktiḥ parā sadātasmācchaktiśca muktiśca strīrūpī śaktirūpiṇīmuktestu kāraṇaṃ devi bhaktiḥ paramadurlabhāmūlādhārasthitaṃ bhūmiṃ svādhiṣṭhānasvarūpakamviśuddhau ca maheśāni ākāśaṃ kamalānanetadūrdhve parameśāni padmamūrdhvamukhaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadāśivapuraṃ prāpya śuddhasphaṭikasannibhammahānandigaṇākīrṇaṃ manasā bhāvayet sadāānandapulakodbhūte jīvo bhavati sundaribahuratnasamākīrṇaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ manoharamśravaṇe kuṇḍalopete ratnahāreṇa śobhitamaṣṭabāhu/ trinayanaṃ śivaṃ padmadalekṣaṇamevaṃ sthūlavapustasya bhāvayet kamalānanesūkṣmantu paramaṃ divyaṃ nirīhaṃ jaḍavat sadāsthūladhyānaṃ maheśāni kṛtvā mokṣamavāpnuyātādau sthūlatanuṃ devi sampūjya kamalānanetejaśca parameśāni prakṛtirmohinīti catasmāt sarvāsu pūjsāsu śaktiḥ prādhānyamucyatedhyānaṃ kṛtvā sūkṣmatanoḥ sthūlaṃ vinyasya tatra vaiśyāmalaṃ pītavāsañca vanamālāvibhūṣitamśrīvatsaśobhitaṃ vakṣo ratnahāreṇa śobhitamprasannanetrakamalaṃ caraṇe nūpuraṃ priyepūrayantaṃ jagad devi satataṃ kamalānanesūkṣmaṃ hi niścalaṃ dehaṃ sūkṣmā prakṛtirūpiṇīyattu dhyānaṃ dhāraṇañca samādhiśca śucismitedhyānañca parameśāni sarvāṅgacintanaṃ priyeidantu dhāraṇākhyātaṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādarameṣā samādhirvijñeyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇāmayoktaṃ yat tad deveśi sarvaṃ śaktimayaṃ smṛtamyathā pūjāṃ yathā dhyānaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ samācaretkṛpayā kathaya me nātha tavāhaṃ paricārikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣaṇārddhaṃ na hi jīvāmi tvāṃ vinā kamalekṣaṇeśivo'haṃ parameśāni mṛtyuṃ jitvā varānanemamāpi parameśāni tanuvajrasamaṃ sadāantare tvāṃ maheśāni vibhāvya sūkṣmarūpiṇībāhyajñānaṃ mayā devi jāyate mama yoginīdṛṣṭvā taccaraṇadvandvaṃ tava vaktraṃ varānaneprakārācca maheśāni śṛṇu samprati madvacaḥsadyogatvaṃ maheśāni svāgamaṃ kathayāmi tevijñānena mataṃ devi devamātarameva cadarśanāni tathā devi sakalāni pṛthak pṛthaksvāgamāśca prasūyante satataṃ parameśvarihṛdaye mama deveśi saṃsthitaṃ kamalānanesvāgamaṃ bhāvitaṃ devi tatkṣaṇe parameśvariantardhyānaṃ samāhṛtya bāhyadṛṣṭiṃ sadā mamavibhāvya parameśāni svāgamaṃ hṛdayātmanisvāgamaṃ lakṣagranthaṃ hi nānā vidyā śucismitesvāgamaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmāṇḍabījamavyamnānāśāstre ca vidyāsu svāgamastu praśasyateśive viṣṇau maheśāni sūrye ca naganandiniśaṅkhāva(saṃkhyayaiva)kramāddevi śaktiḥ sarvatra gīyate|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde navamaḥ paṭalaḥtatsarvaṃ parameśāni śaktirūpaṃ na cānyathājīvasya brahmaṇaścāpi ekatāṃ yatnataścaretjapañca parameśāni manasā ca samācarettata ājñāpurīṃ nītvā bhāvayediṣṭadevatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśuddhaṃ prati deveśi lambayenmano vidyayāṣaṭcakre parameśāni dhyātvā jaganmayīṃ śivāmnirīhāṃ niścalāṃ ramyāṃ mahāyogamayīṃ parāmviṣatantumayīṃ devīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīmmanasā parameśāni japedaṣṭaśataṃ priyeśuddhadhyānañca varṇānāṃ yogapadmasthitāṃ parāmbhujaṅgarūpiṇīṃ devīṃ nityāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ parāmyogapathe maheśāni japedaṣṭaśataṃ punaḥbhujaṅgabhṛṅgasaṅkāśaṃ maṇipūraṃ mahāprabhamtato jīvo maheśāni tatkṣaṇād brahmacāpnuyātdhyātvā brahmamayīṃ śuddhāṃ japedaṣṭaśataṃ priyesvādhiṣṭhānaṃ maheśāni śuddhasphaṭikasannibhamsaṃyojya paramāṃ divyāṃ śivena saha pārvatiindriyāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ hi manaḥ sarvatra gīyateparaṃ brahmamayaṃ bhūtvā japedaṣṭaśataṃ tathāgudapadmaṃ maheśāni mūlādhāraṃ prakīrtitambhāvayet parameśānaṃ sindhuvaruṇavigrahammanasā saṃyuto bhūtvā japedaṣṭaśataṃ tathā|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde daśamaḥ paṭalaḥsa siddhaḥ sa gamaḥ so'pi mama tulyaḥ sadā priyesaptānāṃ koṭividyānāṃ mantrāṇāñca varānaneaprakāśyamidaṃ tattvaṃ paśorgopyaṃ sadā priyesarvāsāṃ naranārīṇāṃ sampuṭaṃ haṃsapakṣiṇamśaktiprasādād deveśi lakṣavarṣaṃ gatastadāsampuṭe paramāṃ vidyāṃ sarvavidyāsvarūpiṇīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedamātāṃ sadā vandhyāṃ yoginīṃ yogarūpiṇīmpraṇamāmi sadā śuddhāṃ nityāṃ vigraharūpiṇīmsarihariṃ samuddhṛtya tadanu kāñcanaṃ priyeaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā ṣaṭpadme kamalekṣaṇeekadhā tu samuddhṛtya bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaretanyathā viphalā pūjā japañca viphalaṃ priyecaturyugajapāddevi yatphalaṃ labhate nṛṇāmekoccāreṇa deveśi mama toṣo na saṃśayaḥvibhāvya satataṃ devi ṣaṭcakraṃ satataṃ śiveanyathā parameśāni mahāvidyāṃ varānaneanyathā parameśāni pretavat sakalaṃ bhavettantraṃ tantrasya vakṣyāmi bhūtaśuddhiṃ bhaved yathākrodhamohayutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ īṣatpiṅgaṃ varānanepañcānāmapi vāyūnāṃ śuddhiṃ nāsti varānanerodanañca tathāmūrcchāṃ bhramañca kamalānanebhūtaśuddhestu mantrāṇi nigadāmi śṛṇu priyetato raudrī maheśāni triprakāraṃ varānanebindvarddhasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā vidyāṃ bhava vimocinīmsarvāsāṃ mantravidyānāṃ pitā mātā ca mātṛkāpurātanīmavijñāya bhūtaśuddhiṃ karoti yaḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ maheśāni japapūjāṃ na śaṃśate|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurīsaṃvāde ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥmahāyogeśvaraḥ so'pi mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥśīghraṃ sidhyati deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāyogajñānaṃ tapaḥ śāstraṃ vidyā śilpāni yāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramavyamnigadāmi śṛṇu prājñe nīrajāyatalocanekāmabījaṃ maheśāni triruccārya śucismitetatastu parameśāni trividhaṃ kāmamuddharetbhāgavatākhyāṃ mahāvidyāṃ daśadhā japamācarettadeva parameśāni dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyātvidyāṃ kalpadrumākārāṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadāmgīyate parameśāni nityā prakṛtirūpiṇīajñānād yadi vā mohāt kāmādvā kamalekṣaṇesarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi kutaḥ pūjā kutaḥ sukhamvaiśyatvaṃ sahasāyāti vaiśyaḥ śūdratvamāpnuyātbrāhmaṇatvaṃ tato yāti sahasā parameśvaribrāhmaṇo'pi naraśreṣṭhaḥ sākṣād brahma na saṃśayaḥiyaṃ vidyā varārohe sadā bhāgavatābhidhāajñātvā parameśāni purāṇaṃ yastu vācayettasmād yatnena deveśi varjanīyaḥ sa tu dvijaḥvahnijāyānvitāṃ vidyāṃ śūdrasya kathamuccaretprajapet satataṃ devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāprajapet sahasā devi tadā siddhiśca jāyateśūdrasya parameśāni vidyāṃ bhāgavatīṃ śṛṇuprathamaṃ caturdaśaṃ dattvā svayaṃ praṇavarūpiṇīmśūdro'pi parameśāni vaiśyatvaṃ yāti tatkṣaṇātimāṃ bhāgavatīṃ vidyāṃ svāgamaṃ viddhi pārvatitava snehāt samākhyātaṃ sugopyaṃ kamalekṣaṇeśūdrasya sakalaṃ devi kathayāmi varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahnijāyāṃ pare dattvā manmathatrayamuddharetiti te kathitaṃ tattvaṃ mahābhaktyā varānaneśāntāya ṛjave devi bhaktiścāṇḍālajātiṣuabhaktabhyo'pi putrebhyo na dadyāt kamalekṣaṇeabhaktebhyo'pi putrebhyastatra mṛtyumavāpnuyāttatsarvaṃ parameśāni śaktiyuktaṃ suniścitamrūpādi yāni tattvāni tāni tattvāni kuṇḍalīrasastu ṣaḍvidhaḥ svāhā nānāsvādaḥ syānniścitamanyāni yāni tattvāni caturviṃśati sundariśuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ haritaṃ kṛṣṇameva caevaṃ sarvaṃ vijānīyāt sadā śaktimayaṃ priye|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre haragaurisaṃvāde dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥpraṇavaṃ prathamaṃ devi uddhṛtya kamalānanetataḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ samuddharetkāmabījaṃ samuddhṛtya praṇavamuddharet tataḥtataḥ paraṃ maheśāni kandarpamuddharet priyeeṣā tu parameśāni vidyā saptadaśākṣarīśākteṣu parameśāni daśavidyā suśasyatesarvaśaktimayīṃ vidyāṃ na japet yadi pāmaraḥvṛthā pūjā maheśāni japastasya vṛthā bhavetprāṇāyāmaṃ maheśāni tathaivācamanaṃ priyetasmādādau japed vidyāṃ saptadaśākṣarīṃ priyesarvaśāstreṣu deveśi vaiṣṇave ca viśeṣataḥādau vidyā maheśāni daśadhā japamācarettataḥ paraṃ maheśāni prāṇāyāmaṃ varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ dattvā āsanāni samācaret|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥśatakoṭi japenāpi tasya vidyā na sidhyatietattattvaṃ mahādeva kṛpayā vada śaṅkaratathā ca mantracaitanyaṃ nirvāṇapadamuttamammūlādhāre mūlavidyāṃ bhāvayediṣṭadevatāmbhāvayedakṣaraśreṇīmiṣṭavidyāṃ sanātanīmdhyānaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni muhūrttārddhaṃ tataḥ paramsvādhiṣṭhānaṃ tato gatvā bhāvayediṣṭadevatāmvibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ padmamadhyagatāṃ śubhāmmaṇipūraṃ tato gatvā bhāvayediṣṭadevatāmśuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśāṃ śivavakṣopari sthitāmhṛtpadmaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ nīrajāyatalocanevibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ mahāmarakataprabhāmtatpadmagahanaṃ gatvā pakṣiṇā jīva pārvativibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ haridvarṇaṃ varānanepakṣiṇā saha deveśi khañjanākṣi śucismitevibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ caturvarṇānurañjitāmṣaṭcakre parameśāni dhyānaṃ kṛtvā śucismitetadeva parameśāni mantrārthaṃ viddhi pārvatiprayayau paramaṃ ramyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padamkauśikīṃ satataṃ devi purīṃ śaktimayīṃ priyevibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīmamṛtāntu rasāyanīmnānāratnasamākīrṇaṃ tanmūlaṃ kamalānanepañcabhūtātmakaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pañcaśākhāsamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturvarṇayutaṃ puṣpaṃ śuklaṃ raktaṃ śucismiteharitañca maheśāni vicitraṃ sarvamohanamanyāni yāni śākhāni kṣudrāṇi nīlalocanetvagasthimedhāmajjāni vṛkṣaśākhāni ca priyesarvaśaktimayīṃ devi divyāṃ nīrajalocaneitihāsapurāṇāni sarvāṇi vṛkṣasaṃsthitamnānāpakṣiyutaṃ ramyaṃ divyastrīgaṇasaṃyutambandhubhiḥ śobhitaṃ devi gaṇairatnādikāṅkṣabhiḥcandrakoṭisamaṃ devi sarvakoṭisamaprabhamnānāpuṣpasamūhena racitaṃ hemamālayājīvaḥ pakṣiyuto devi bhāvayet tatra pārvatievaṃ kalpadrumaṃ dhyātvā tadadho ratnavedikāmkāminīkoṭisaṃyuktaṃ cāmarairhastasaṃsthitamyasya yasya maheśāni yadiṣṭaṃ kamalānanejīvo dhyānaparo bhūtvā japedaṣṭaśataṃ priyekṛtvā jīvaḥ prasannātmā japedaṣṭaśataṃ priyeanena kramato devi caitanyaṃ viddhi sundarina kasmaicit pravaktavyaṃ yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥśiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya prakāśayetviṣṇumantre maheśāni śivamantre'pyupāsatetataḥ siddho bhavenmantro vidyā ca kamalānanebrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍamadhye tu viharet sa ca sādhakaḥcaitanyarahitaṃ devi yo japet na ca pāpakṛttava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ dāso'haṃ tava sundaritvadvaktrāmbujapīyūṣapānena kamalānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ devi tava rūpamayaṃ sadākṛpāmayi maheśāni prakṛtiḥ śarīramāśritāsatītvaṃ paramaṃ prāptā idānīṃ pārvatī priyepārvaṃtītvaṃ gatā bhadre menakāyāṃ śucismiteiti dhyānaṃ samāgacchan bhūtvā tiṣṭhāmi sundarisvāvāsaṃ śaktirūpaṃ sadā yat hṛdi saṃsthitamnānāvidyāsu deveśi daśa vidyā pragīyatejapitvā lakṣavarṣāṇi svāgamaṃ śaktirūpiṇamdhyānamārgaṃ parityajya tava pādeṣu gīyatesvāgamaṃ hi vinā devi na kiñcid varttate priyesvāgamācca prasūyante koṭiśaḥ kuṇḍa (ma) gnayaḥpurāṇāni maheśāni tandraṇi vividhāni catat sarvaṃ parameśāni svāgamāt kamalānanesthitiñca kurute viṣṇuḥ svāgamāt naganandinibrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sarve svāgamarūpiṇaḥtejaḥpuñjaṃ maheśāni yaduktaṃ kamalānanesvāgamaṃ muktikaivalyaṃ nirvāṇapadamavyayamrahasyaṃ svāgamopetaṃ prasaṅgāt kathitaṃ mayā|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥyaḥ kuryānmātṛkānyāsaṃ sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ vighnastasya pade padedvārakānāyakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥyāṃ kṛtvāpi yuge yugemātṛkāvarṇamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kamalānaneśrīrāmaśca maheśāni ayodhyāyāṃ varānanedaśavarṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyamācīkarat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātṛkāvarṇamāśritya sarvaṃ kuryādraghūttamaḥpūrvoktatantravad devi sarvaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥtato japaṃ mātṛkāyāḥ kuryāt sādhakayatnataḥtatastu mātṛkādhyānaṃ bahirnyāsaṃ tataḥ paramevamaṣṭamakaṃ devi mātṛkānyāsamācaretnyāsasya parameśāni varasya gururūpakamtriguṇasya maheśāni nyāsaṃ vakṣyāmi saṃśṛṇuśivaviṣṇubrahmayutaṃ bindvardhvacandrasaṃyutamsarvopari maheśāni bindu brahmasvarūpiṇampañcāśanmātṛkāsthāne triguṇaṃ nyāsamācaretnyāsasya parameśāni rahasyaṃ paramādbhutamgatañca parameśāni tridhā vartanato bhavetaṣṭottaraśataṃ devi bhinnāyāṃ triguṇaṃ nyasettriguṇanyāsamātreṇa adhikārīti gīyatenyāsañca vividhaṃ devi nānātantreṣu gīyatenyāsānāṃ parameśāni mātṛkā viśvamohinītasmāttu yatnato devi mātṛkānyāsamācaretataḥ paraṃ mātṛkāyāḥ ṣoḍhā mokṣapradāyinīṣoḍhā ca viphalaṃ tasya mātṛkā viphalaṃ bhavetsaphalāni sadā tasya anyathā rodanaṃ vaneṣoḍhā tu parameśāni sākṣād brahmasvarūpiṇībrahmaviṣṇunutāṃ ramyāṃ mama sampuṭasaṃsthitāmmātṛṣoḍhāṃ varārohe sāvadhānāvadhārayatriguṇe puṭitāṃ kṛtvā pañcāśanmātṛkāṃ priyeprathamamanulome tu vilomaṃ tadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetprapañcānāṃ dale devi prathamaṃ nyāsamācaretśūdrastu parameśāni caturdaśasvaraṃ nyasettasmāt sarvatra śūdrastu dīrghapraṇavamucyate|| iti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥjīvaśuddhiṃ manaḥśuddhiṃ prāṇāyāmamidaṃ smṛtamprāṇāyāmaṃ vinā devi na pūjāṃ na japañcaretjapadhyānādibhiryuktaṃ sagarbhaṃ kamalānanepūrayet ṣoḍaśairvāyumiḍayā parameśvarirecayet kumbhakārdhena nāḍyā madhyamayā sadāprāṇāyāmaṃ maheśāni mahāyogamayaṃ sadādvayordvayornāmayogo brahmasaṃsiddhikāraṇamyasya yasya ca devasya yathā bhūṣaṇavāhanampūrakaṃ dhārakaṃ devi recakaṃ naganandini---------------------vedānte brahma nirṇitamnyāse ca parameśāni īśvaraṃ nyāsasammatammīmāṃsayā tathā devi brahmakarma pragīyatetatpuro'pyasti deveśi guptabrahma sanātanametat sarvaṃ maheśāni śavarūpaṃ nirindriyamtasmāt sarveṣu deveṣu śakteḥ prādhānyamucyatesadā tāñca namāmyātmabhūtaye kamalekṣaṇeśavatvaṃ sarvadeveṣu vinā śaktiṃ śucismiteśaktiyuktaṃ yadā brahma tadā devatvamāpnuyātsvāgame sarvavedāni nānātantrāṇi vidyatetasmāttu parameśāni sarvaṃ prakṛtimayaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00130 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādhārañca tathā deyaṃ pāṇḍityaṃ yastu pārvatitatsarvaṃ parameśāni śaktiṃ vidyāt śucismiteśabdabrahma paraṃbrahma śaktiyuktaṃ sadā priyeśabdasya kāraṇaṃ devi mātṛkāṃ brahmarūpiṇīmna kasmaicit pravaktavyaṃ yadīcchet śubhamātmanaḥiti śrībhūtaśuddhitantre harapārvatīsaṃvāde ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥpraśastaṃ syāt sadā devi nānyathā mama bhāṣitamnotpātastatra deveśi na ca bhītiḥ kadācanana ca mārībhayaṃ tatra na ca rogastadā priyetatphalaṃ labhate devi pustakasya ca pūjanātkāmarūpasamaṃ devi tadgṛhaṃ bhuvi durlabhamkāśyādīni ca tīrthāni sarvāṇi tasya mandiresarvadevamayaḥ sarvadevamayaḥ sadāsarvāgamamayaṃ so'pi sa nānyathā tu kadācanasarvaśāstrasamaḥ so'pi nānyathā vacanaṃ mama
